entities.summary: Denotes a wide socio-cultural region comprising parts of west asia, the south caucasus, central asia, south asia, and east asia, all of which have been affected, to some degree, by the iranian peoples and the iranian languages. Greater Iran is a historical region. A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
